title: [Contrastive Learning as Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/pdf/22
summary: Contrastive RL casts contrastive representation learning over action-labeled trajectories as a goal-conditioned RL algorithm in its own right, so the inner product of the learned representations is itself the goal-conditioned value function. Meridian is evaluating it as a simpler replacement for our auxiliary-loss-heavy goal-conditioned agent stack, including on image-based tasks.
